_comment: Default cheap fact-checker models per harness. Model ids are public strings, not secrets. 'model: null' means use the harness's own configured default. Override per run with --model/--variant. Rates are approximate list prices (USD per 1M tokens) for cost awareness only.

zcode.note: z.ai GLM Coding Plan, flat rate - effectively free per check
zcode.cost_note: GLM Coding Plan is flat-rate: marginal USD cost is ~0; the estimated figure is list-price equivalent for awareness only.

claude.note: null = session default (covered by Max subscription). For per-token API use, pass e.g. --model claude-haiku-4-5

codex.note: null = config.toml default; ChatGPT plan credits. Flash models + variant low keep costs down

kimi.note: Moderato plan default; usage events not exposed by -p mode

grok.note: default model; end event reports native cost

agy.note: Antigravity OAuth; no per-run usage surfaced
